_readme: HUMAN OVERRIDES for ru. This file is hand-maintained and always wins.
scripts/translate.mjs READS this file and merges it on top of DeepL's
output. It never writes to, modifies, or deletes this file.
To fix a bad translation, add the key HERE -- do not edit ru.json,
which is regenerated and overwritten on every run.
Add real entries as siblings of this _readme key, e.g.:
Keys must match public/locales/en.json. Any {placeholder} tokens and
emoji in the English string must appear in the override too -- the
generator validates overrides exactly like generated text and will
refuse to write the locale if they don't match.
This _readme key is ignored: the merge only considers keys that exist
in en.json. (JSON has no comment syntax, hence a key.)
